rationale: A generic render-backend change. SkiaSurface gains a GPU trim entry (unused_for and everything levels), a throttled idle trim from end_frame and gpu_cache_bytes; it frees only resources nothing references, so presented pixels are unchanged. Pulp continues to own these targets under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits the change when the targets adopt the Vellum package. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'GpuIdleTrimSchedule is due once per interval'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim frees textures unused for two seconds and keeps the drawn one'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim runs once per second of frames'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface trim everything returns released image textures to the device'
